name: LC Speed Boost half-size steps
plain: Runs early steps of a flow sample on a half-size latent, then grows and continues at full size. Disabled on masks or low-noise starts per printed reasons.
math: Inner sampler on half latent for j of n steps, grow, run remainder. Swap of half_positive conditioning supported.
label: from code

audit.note: Not flow-only: kind can be "flow" or "sigma" (SDXL family eps/v), and only other types are refused (lonecatone23__ComfyUI_LC123_nodes/lc_speed_boost.py:87-101, 250-251). Grow also changes the noise level: the remainder restarts at returned t2, not sigmas[j] (lines 280-282). Other off reasons include auto-off models and MOSS layout.
